summary: NAINA OS Volume 7 — Cognitive Architecture & Reasoning Framework (CARF v1.0). Covers Document 07.1 (5 Thinking Layers), Document 07.2 (Planning Engine), Document 07.3 (Decision Engine), Document 07.4 (Reflection Engine), Document 07.5 (Learning Engine), Document 07.6 (Goal Engine), Document 07.7 (Autonomous Workflow Engine), Document 07.8 (Skill Engine), Document 07.9 (Multi-Step Reasoning Protocol), Document 07.10 (Self-Evaluation Framework), and the flagship Executive Function Engine (EFE).
